## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A test proves aca backup run, aca sync, and the artifacts tarball builder...

The system SHALL ensure that a test proves aca backup run, aca sync, and the artifacts tarball builder each skip a populated ~/.aca/browser-profiles/ directory.

#### Scenario: A test proves aca backup run, aca sync, and the artifacts tarball builder...

WHEN `exclude-browser-profile-directory-from-backup-and-sync` is implemented
THEN A test proves aca backup run, aca sync, and the artifacts tarball builder each skip a populated ~/.aca/browser-profiles/ directory.

### Requirement: docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md lists ~/.aca/browser-profiles/ as an excluded path

The system SHALL ensure that docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md lists ~/.aca/browser-profiles/ as an excluded path.

#### Scenario: docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md lists ~/.aca/browser-profiles/ as an excluded path

WHEN `exclude-browser-profile-directory-from-backup-and-sync` is implemented
THEN docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md lists ~/.aca/browser-profiles/ as an excluded path.
